newsitem.title: USA: Florida Boy, 7, kills playmate with mother's gun.
newsitem.headline: Florida Boy, 7, kills playmate with mother's gun.

text.p: A 7-year-old boy accidentally shot and killed a playmate Monday night after finding his mother's gun in their Pembroke Pines apartment, a city spokeswoman said Tuesday.
Rondale Diaz, 8, was pronounced dead from a head wound on arrival at a hospital, Mary Ann Flanagan, information officer for Pembroke Pines, told Reuters.
The seven-year-old's mother, Althena O'Connor, 27, has been charged with culpable negligence, Flanagan added.
